name: One Illidari Intuition per caster on each recipient (#4718)
contract: Illidari Intuition 800212 (aura 29, Agility, TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY) and Greater Illidari Intuition 680308 (aura 29, Agility, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER_AREA_RAID) are separate spells and no spell_group listed them, so Aura::CanStackWith let the single-target and the raid version of the same buff stay on one recipient. 800212 is the first rank of the chain in spell_ranks (800212 -> 501326 -> 501327 -> 501328 -> 501329), so it stands for every rank. They share spell group 1141 with stack rule 2 (SPELL_GROUP_STACK_RULE_EXCLUSIVE_FROM_SAME_CASTER): the newest replaces the caster's previous one, while a second Felsworn's still coexists - the same shape as the Templar Gift group.

steps.label: Greater Illidari Intuition from the same caster
Greater Illidari Intuition reaches the ally
It replaced the same caster's Illidari Intuition
A second Felsworn gives Illidari Intuition
The other caster's Illidari Intuition coexists (rule 2, not rule 1)
